subtitle: Learn recruiting in Lagos, one step at a time. Plan about 5 hours a week. Free resources come first; paid options are marked.

orientation.title: What recruiters do
orientation.description: Learn the hiring process from workforce planning to onboarding, and where recruiters work with hiring managers.
outcomes: Trace hiring from workforce planning to onboarding
Compare agency and in-house recruiter roles
Use clear criteria instead of gut feel

foundations.title: Fair hiring basics
foundations.description: Learn fair hiring, job requirements, selection steps and the rules for candidate data in Nigeria.
outcomes: Follow a fair hiring process
Separate job requirements from person specifications
Handle candidate data with care

define-role.title: Define the role
define-role.description: Define the work and what success looks like before you source candidates.
outcomes: Turn a vague request into a job description
Set clear hiring criteria before interviews
Build a scorecard for every interviewer

sourcing.title: Find candidates
sourcing.description: Find candidates, write clear outreach and treat people well throughout hiring.
outcomes: Write Boolean searches for a real role
Compare referrals, job boards and direct search
Plan outreach and candidate updates

screening.title: Screen and shortlist
screening.description: Use job criteria to shortlist fairly before you speak with candidates.
outcomes: Screen CVs against the scorecard
Ask everyone the same job-related questions
Record clear reasons for each decision

interviewing.title: Interview and decide
interviewing.description: Ask job-related questions and score answers against a shared rubric.
outcomes: Write behavioural and hypothetical questions
Set clear examples for scoring answers
Run a mock interview and compare scores

nigerian-law.title: Offers, onboarding and Nigerian law
nigerian-law.description: Learn the basics of offers, onboarding, data protection and employment law in Nigeria.
outcomes: Explain why candidate data needs a lawful basis
Draft a short privacy notice
Know when to check the law or ask a lawyer

career-tools.title: Tools, metrics and job search
career-tools.description: Bring your work together, track hiring metrics and apply for junior roles in Lagos.
outcomes: Track a practice hiring pipeline
Show one hiring project in a portfolio
Apply with evidence, not just certificates

hr-essentials.why: Learn what HR does, then see where recruiting fits in the employee life cycle.
hr-essentials.action: Watch lessons 1–4. Sketch the employee life cycle and mark where recruitment fits.
hr-essentials.access_summary: Public playlist; no sign-in to read. Playback untested. AI-assisted, introductory content.
hr-essentials.duration: 1 hour for starter lessons and notes

talent-acquisition.why: Get the key terms and a quick tour of job analysis, sourcing, selection and hiring.
talent-acquisition.action: Watch the first five lessons. Draw the hiring process in your own words.
talent-acquisition.access_summary: Public playlist; no sign-in to read. Playback untested. AI-assisted; check key claims.
talent-acquisition.duration: About 2 hours for selected lessons and notes

openlearn-recruitment.why: See how job analysis leads to a job description and person specification.
openlearn-recruitment.action: Read sections 4.2–4.5. Draft a job analysis, job description and person specification for a Lagos vacancy. Tie each criterion to the work.
openlearn-recruitment.access_summary: Free to read without sign-in. Account for quizzes and the free participation statement. Older UK-law examples; use Nigerian sources too.

saylor-bus301.why: Review staffing plans, job analysis, interviews, tests and offers through readings, videos and practice.
saylor-bus301.action: Complete Units 2–3: readings, videos and practice. Skip the other units.
saylor-bus301.access_summary: Free course and certificate; account needed to enroll. U.S. law examples, not Nigerian law.

onet-job-analysis.why: Set role requirements from the work, not from another job advert.
onet-job-analysis.action: Search O*NET for your practice role. Pick five duties to check against Nigerian job ads.
onet-job-analysis.access_summary: Free public database; no account needed. U.S. data, not Nigerian requirements.

workable-job-templates.why: See how a recruiter role summary, duties and requirements fit together.
workable-job-templates.action: Compare the sample with a Lagos vacancy. Keep supported requirements and mark each essential or desirable.
workable-job-templates.access_summary: Free sample; no sign-in to read. The 15-day software trial is separate and not needed.

greenhouse-scorecard.why: Learn the six steps of structured hiring, starting with clear success criteria.
greenhouse-scorecard.action: Download the worksheet. Build a scorecard for your practice role with up to six criteria.
greenhouse-scorecard.access_summary: Free article and two PDFs; no account or form. The method works beyond Greenhouse.

workable-boolean.why: Use search operators to find candidates by role, skill and location.
workable-boolean.action: Write three Boolean strings for a Lagos role. Test with dummy terms; do not collect real CVs or personal data.
workable-boolean.access_summary: Free article and PDF; no sign-in or form. The software trial is separate.

hrlab-sourcing-video.why: Compare sourcing options such as referrals, job boards, pipelines and job fairs.
hrlab-sourcing-video.action: Watch the video. Pick two channels for a small Lagos employer and explain why.
hrlab-sourcing-video.access_summary: Public video and transcript; no sign-in or payment. Playback untested. AI-assisted overview.

google-hiring-guides.why: Plan clear candidate updates, interview preparation and respectful decisions.
google-hiring-guides.action: Draft a first-contact message and an update plan for a Lagos role. Include interview prep and delay updates.
google-hiring-guides.access_summary: Free guide; no account or form. Google examples, not Nigerian law or guaranteed results.

openlearn-shortlisting.why: Practise comparing candidates against a job specification.
openlearn-shortlisting.action: Read section 4.10 and do its shortlisting activity. Give one job-related reason per choice; check your assumptions.
openlearn-shortlisting.access_summary: Free to read without sign-in. Account for course activities and the free participation statement. Older UK examples; use Nigerian sources too.
openlearn-shortlisting.cost: Free to read; account for course extras

hrlab-screening-candidates.why: Review screening steps from CVs to references.
hrlab-screening-candidates.action: Watch the video. Draft five phone-screen questions tied to job criteria. Use fictional records; do not judge protected or irrelevant traits.
hrlab-screening-candidates.access_summary: Public video and transcript; no sign-in. Playback untested. AI-assisted; U.S. law is not Nigerian guidance.

google-structured-interviews.why: Learn to set criteria, write interview questions and score answers consistently.
google-structured-interviews.action: Write eight questions: four behavioural and four hypothetical. Link each to your Stage 3 scorecard and add poor and strong answer examples.
google-structured-interviews.access_summary: Free guide; no account. Google examples and results are not local guarantees.

google-interviewer-training.why: Give useful feedback with evidence and leave time for candidate questions.
google-interviewer-training.action: After the mock interview, rewrite your notes with evidence so another person can follow your decision.
google-interviewer-training.access_summary: Free guide; no account. Guidance, not a formal qualification.

ndpc-gaid.why: Learn the data-protection rules recruiters meet when they handle CVs and references.
ndpc-gaid.action: Read Articles 15, 16, 17, 18, 27, 33 and 34. Draft a six-line privacy notice for a job application.
ndpc-gaid.access_summary: Public NDPC PDF; no sign-in or payment. Only opening provisions checked. Not legal advice.

nigeria-labour-act.why: Review recruiting rules and the written terms employers must give workers.
nigeria-labour-act.action: Read sections 7, 23, 24, 25, 26 and 71. Write three questions to ask before sourcing for an employer.
nigeria-labour-act.access_summary: Public PLAC copy; no account or payment. Not a government gazette; the law may have changed. Ask a Nigerian lawyer.

google-onboarding.why: Use new-hire check-ins to spot gaps in tools, skills and support.
google-onboarding.action: Draft a 30-day onboarding checklist. Give each item an owner and check-in date.
google-onboarding.access_summary: Free guide; no account. Google examples; adapt them for a Lagos employer.

hubspot-contacts.why: Use a free CRM as a simple stand-in for an applicant tracking system.
hubspot-contacts.action: Create a free Academy account. Add ten fictional candidates to the free CRM, track their stages and count the funnel. Never upload real candidate data.
hubspot-contacts.access_summary: Free 20-minute lesson; Academy account needed. The CRM tier does not expire or need a credit card; paid tiers exist.

hrlab-hiring-metrics.why: Learn key hiring measures, including time to fill and selection ratio.
hrlab-hiring-metrics.action: Watch the video. Note the selection-ratio and time-to-fill formulas, then calculate stage conversions in your fictional pipeline.
hrlab-hiring-metrics.access_summary: Public video and transcript; no sign-in. Playback untested. AI-assisted primer; verify key decisions with primary sources.

greenhouse-metrics.why: See how hiring funnel rates vary by company size in a U.S. case study.
greenhouse-metrics.action: Read the summary and funnel tables. Note how rates vary by company size, then calculate your practice-pipeline rates.
greenhouse-metrics.access_summary: Free direct PDF; no account or form. U.S. Greenhouse customer data through August 2026, not a Nigerian benchmark.
